title: Order and Inventory Integration Hub
opportunity_summary: Replace 31 point-to-point interfaces with a managed integration hub on AWS connecting SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce Service Cloud, Shopify Plus, a 3PL that exchanges CSV files over SFTP, and a Snowflake warehouse. Event-driven order and inventory flows plus scheduled file exchanges, with retries, dead-letter handling, sequence-gap detection and a daily three-way reconciliation. Inventory accuracy must be fixed before the 2026 peak.
requested_by: Petra Lindqvist, Head of Retail Technology, Vellamo Retail Group

demo_change.description: The steering group raises contingency from 15% to 25% because the 3PL file interface is the programme's largest dependency, and the 3PL order-release and dispatch file integration is re-rated from medium to high complexity (sequence-gap detection, duplicate handling and replay for two file formats).
